label: The template: rails, wells and devices
section: The template: rails, wells and devices
subgoals: Run VDD and VSS rails along the cell's top and bottom edges

Order transistors to share diffusion between neighbours

label: Height in tracks, width in poly pitches
section: Height in tracks, width in poly pitches
subgoals: Multiply the track count by the metal pitch to get cell height
Multiply the CPP count by the poly pitch to get cell width
Multiply width by height for the cell area
